# KeyboardChanged <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Keyboard](BlitzBasic-Keyboard)

</div>


```blitzbasic
KeyboardChanged:Int32
```

**Returns:** True if the keyboard was used, False if not or if there is no such keyboard.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Tells if the user did anything with a keyboard since the last time this was asked, which is handy to find out what to play with.
Asking clears the answer. Plugging in a new keyboard counts as using it once.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
While Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	If KeyboardChanged() Then Text 10, 10, "The keyboard was used"
	Flip
Wend
```
